messages.label: a reader we could not rule out

cards.title: Three hops live outside every repository we own
items: The transfer task is configuration in a product, not code in a branch
The encryption key sits in our config and the vendor's, tracked by neither
Whether they allowlist our source addresses is a line in a file we never see

cards.title: What tracing the return direction turned up
items: A path the mainframe could use to read the response, and a job with the access
It is not proven, and nobody could tell me it does not happen
Our cutover plan contained a step that removed that directory

cards.title: What the inventory format changed
items: One row per hop: what triggers it, what it reads, what it writes, who owns it
The owner column does most of the work, and two hops had no owner
Ask who else reads this, not what consumes this next
